entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something? I'm not really sure how this all works, the website was a bit overwhelming.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me your name and the item you're calling about?
My name is Sarah Gable. It's about a cycling jersey I bought a while back.
Okay, Sarah, I see your account. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's... well, it's the wrong size. I finally tried it on and it's just way too tight. I don't know what to do. I looked online but I got lost. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm happy to help sort this out. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered about 50 days ago.
Is that bad? I wasn't sure if I waited too long. Everything is so confusing.

Not at all. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days. You're unfortunately outside that window. We can absolutely process this for you. Would you prefer a refund, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. Thank you so much. I'd love to do an exchange for the next size up, if that's possible.

It's definitely possible. I've just initiated the exchange process for you. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid return label. Just pack up the jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the new size to you immediately.
Wow, okay. That sounds much easier. Thank you, David. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
